annotations.title: Add a presenter to any video

description: Put a PRESENTER on ANY video, only when the user asks for one: their pick of person (`creator`: a saved or preset creator from list_creators; or `image`: a photo they gave; never invent one), filmed on a green screen saying the words, cut out and laid over the video in a bottom corner (default), a round badge, or split screen, lip-synced, block by block across the whole video (about 10 s and about 25 spoken words a block). The words are `script` (verbatim; refused free if it cannot fit) or, without one, written to fit from what the video says and shows (`brief` steers them). The video's own sound stays under the presenter unless baseAudio 'off'; the video without the presenter is kept. A face the video model refuses STOPS it with nothing charged: offer another creator, another photo, or the video as it is. dryRun:true = the exact price, which is what it charges. For a finished make_explainer film, make_explainer with fromFilm.

baseAudio.description: the video's own sound: 'under' the presenter (default) or 'off'

brief.description: without a script: what they should talk about

captions.description: subtitles of what they say; only when asked

creator.description: the presenter: a saved or preset creator, by name or id

dryRun.description: price only: nothing made, nothing charged

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

image.description: or a photo of the presenter (a real person's face follows the real-face rules)

script.description: the exact words to say, used verbatim and split at sentence ends

video.description: the video: an https / upload_file URL, a Library id (L0…), or a local path on the CLI; up to 2 minutes

voice.description: a voice name, only when asked (default: their own voice)

name: add_presenter
title: Add a presenter to any video
